en.NAME: Diagnostics Aware
en.DESCRIPTION: Resource type supporting diagnostics scripting with attributes for diagnostic scripts, time zones, and physical address

en.NAME: Time Zone
en.DESCRIPTION: The timezone where the resource is located

en.NAME: Diagnostic Script
en.DESCRIPTION: The script to execute for diagnosing the resource

en.NAME: Physical Address
en.DESCRIPTION: The physical address of the resource

en.NAME: Diagnostics
en.DESCRIPTION: Attributes related to diagnostics of the resource

en.NAME: Location
en.DESCRIPTION: Attributes related to physical location of the resource
